verdict.rationale: incident.io ships several built-in AI capabilities that take work off responders. Investigations is an agent that gathers evidence, forms hypotheses and tests them against code and telemetry. Other features draft updates, summaries, follow-ups and postmortems, and Scribe transcribes incident calls. The changelog also notes users can now update the status page using the agent, which suggests task delegation beyond read-only analysis. Missing for 10: clear documentation of a conversational assistant that takes arbitrary user-assigned tasks (only one thin changelog mention of acting via the agent), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
